import re

def validate_name(name):
    if not isinstance(name, str):
        return False
    if not (1 <= len(name) <= 32):
        return False
    if not re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$', name):
        return False
    return True

print(validate_name(""))              # False

EOF

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import re
+import subprocess
+import json
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_user_report(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    name = params.get("name")
+    if not isinstance(name, str) or not (1 <= len(name) <= 32) or not re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$', name):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid name"}
+    
+    try:
+        result = subprocess.run(["python3", "scripts/report.py", "--name", name], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
+        report = json.loads(result.stdout)
+        return 200, report
+    except Exception:
+        return 500, {"error": "internal error"}
